articles.title: Russia supplies Iran with cyber support, spy imagery to hone attacks, Ukraine says
articles.summary: Reports suggest Russian satellites extensively surveyed military facilities and critical sites across the Middle East. This intelligence is reportedly assisting Iran in targeting U.S. forces and other strategic locations. This collaboration underscores evolving geopolitical dynamics and potential regional instability, crucial for understanding international defence scenarios.

articles.title: Why Do Grocery Store Apples Look So Shiny? (And Wait, Are They Safe to Eat?)
articles.summary: This article critically examines the popular saying, 'an apple a day keeps the doctor away,' prompting readers to question its factual basis. It begins by observing the apparent freshness of grocery store apples, likely setting the stage to explore their actual nutritional value and efficacy in promoting health, challenging conventional wisdom. This analysis encourages aspirants to maintain a discerning approach to common beliefs.

articles.title: Why Cooper Raiff Is Mounting an Emmy Campaign for Lili Reinhart
articles.summary: During a recent awards season, 'Hal & Harper' creator Cooper Raiff and co-star Lili Reinhart attended a high-profile reception for the biopic 'Song Sung Blue'. Kate Hudson, a prominent figure in the film, subsequently received an Oscar for her role. The event highlighted a significant moment in the entertainment industry's annual celebration of cinematic achievements.
